units.source_text: 薰大将和我定了终身，我这苦命人渐渐有了幸福的希望，岂知又发生了可恨之事，断送了我这一生。

en.t: General Kaoru had pledged himself to me for life, and I, so ill-fated, had gradually begun to hope for happiness; but then, who could have known that hateful events would occur and ruin my whole life?

units.source_text: 思想起来，我当时对匂亲王略微感到一点恋慕之情，实在太不应该！

en.t: When I think back on it, it was truly wrong of me to have felt even the slightest longing for Prince Niou at that time.

units.source_text: 全是为了此人的关系，使我成了飘零之身。

en.t: It was entirely because of my connection with that man that I became a wanderer with no place to belong.

units.source_text: 如此想来，那时他以‘橘岛常青树’为比喻而和我‘结契’，我为什么竟会相信他呢？

en.t: Thinking of it this way, when he used the evergreen trees of Tachibana Island as a pledge and bound himself to me, why did I ever believe him?

units.source_text: 这匂亲王实在可恶之极！

en.t: That Prince Niou is utterly hateful!

units.source_text: 薰大将起初对我淡然，后来爱我之心恒常不变，回想起他的种种情况，实在深可恋慕。

en.t: General Kaoru was distant toward me at first, but later his love for me never changed; when I recall all that about him, I cannot help longing for him deeply.

units.source_text: 如今我还活着，如果被他闻知，我觉得比被别人闻知更加可耻。

en.t: Now that I am still alive, if he were to hear of it, I would feel even more ashamed than if anyone else found out.

units.source_text: 只要我活在世上，也许还能从旁窥见他昔日的风采吧。

en.t: As long as I remain alive in this world, perhaps I may still be able to glimpse from afar the grace he once had.

units.source_text: 哎呀！我这念头还是不行！

en.t: Ah, no! Even this thought of mine is wrong!

units.source_text: 这种事也是不应该想的。”

en.t: This too is something I must not think about."

units.source_text: 她独自在心中反复思量。

en.t: She turned these thoughts over and over in her heart, all alone.

units.source_text: 好容易听到了鸡鸣声，她非常欢喜，设想如果能听到母亲的声音，更是何等欢喜！

en.t: When at last she heard the rooster crow, she was overjoyed, and imagined how much happier she would be if she could hear her mother's voice.

units.source_text: 她想到了天明，觉得心情非常恶劣。

en.t: She kept thinking until dawn, and felt terribly unwell.

units.source_text: 陪她来此的可莫姬还是不来，她只得依旧躺着。

en.t: Lady Kamo, who had accompanied her here, still did not come, so she had no choice but to go on lying there.

units.source_text: 几个打眠鼾的老尼僧很早就起身了，要粥啦，要什么啦，一时啰唣不清。

en.t: Several elderly nuns who had been snoring got up very early, calling for porridge and this and that, making such a clamor for a while that nothing could be made out clearly.

units.source_text: 她们对浮舟说：“你也快来吃一点吧。

en.t: They said to Ukifune, "You should hurry over and eat a little too.
